limitations: Public primary constructors of ordinary nongeneric classes. Explicit nonpublic constructor visibility, inner, value, sealed and enum combinations remain unsupported. Defaults retain the existing 32-parameter mask limit.

Java callers compile exactly once against official output and identical caller classfiles run against both providers with -Xverify:all. Official Kotlin consumers compile against each provider separately.
Android source assessments are separate from feature acceptance; no Android, full-app, or performance claim. Parcelize transformations remain explicitly unsupported.
